role: real-model architecture-compatibility test of adaptive layer quota allocation

sequence_gate.policy: no compatibility-arm prediction before terminal nine-seed P2, frozen score-compatible baseline selection, and audited natural RULER datasets

benchmark.name: RULER
benchmark.paired_unit: same frozen generated example under both compatibility arms

score_compatible_baseline_selection.rule: choose the highest row-weighted mean accuracy from the already frozen Qwen3-1.7B selection artifact, breaking ties lexicographically; do not inspect Qwen3-4B compatibility outcomes
score_compatible_baseline_selection.reason: the protected-prefix and quota wrappers require a direct ScorerPress and cannot silently unwrap AdaKV

fixed+pins.selection: top score positions after forcing protected positions into the same budget

natural-adaptive-quota+pins.layer_signal: normalized entropy concentration of z-scored current-layer scorer values
natural-adaptive-quota+pins.causal_prior: running mean of earlier-layer concentrations only
natural-adaptive-quota+pins.feasibility_rule: clip each allocation so every remaining layer can satisfy its frozen minimum and maximum; the last layer consumes the exact residual
natural-adaptive-quota+pins.selection: top score positions after forcing protected positions into the allocated layer budget

pins.failure_policy: fail closed if pins cannot fit without budget expansion

report: overall and per-length paired accuracy differences
all task-by-length effects and worst regression
hot-resident bytes, peak HBM, latency, and controller time

claim_boundary: This cohort tests a repository-owned causal same-global-budget compatibility controller on a real dense-attention model. It is not an unchanged transfer of the synthetic DeepSeek-style controller, not official DeepSeek-V4 evidence, and is never pooled with the preregistered native-versus-fixed natural suite.
